ratings_why.fun: Hold-or-cast every turn, merging a clogged hand into one huge Phial and aiming through lenses give real choices at each tier, and the late game climbs hard.
ratings_why.distinct: The spell-count core reads like Battlegrounds Nagas; Steep, the Cocoon merge and lens-to-Echo targeting are the fresh parts.

verdict_why: The v1 rule questions are settled and nothing left is broken; more passes would change the tribe without improving it.

points.text: Dame Pavonia compounds, because each Echo scales on her current size and every cast elsewhere feeds her. If the owner wants a brake, scaling Echoes on her start-of-turn stats keeps the idea and makes the growth linear within a turn.

Before Tier 3 the only Phial sources are When played (The Uncertain, Pestle Grinder), so turns 2-4 can have nothing to Steep. A Tier 2 unit that makes a Phial on a trigger would give the early curve a steadier ramp.

Golden Atropos with golden Counter Clerk turns each refresh into about +2 gold and a cast until refresh costs rise. The refresh ramp bounds it, but it is a gold-and-Recipe engine worth the owner's eye.
Counter Clerk at half N is weak: a ripe Phial 5 sells for 2 gold, when casting it is almost always better. Selling at full N, minus 1, would make it a real choice.

Burnet rewards a Cocoon hand that never casts, so a Big Batch player can sit on one growing Phial for the whole game. That is a fine, hot payoff; just check that it doesn't make casting a mistake late.

standouts.why: Cocoon Spinner turns the hand-clog downside into the route past the cap, which makes holding a real build.
The Spectacle makes positioning matter while recruiting: small lens in front, carries behind.
Mother Shipton links the two poles: every big cast leaves a leftover to count, sell, hold or merge.

weakest.why: Half-N gold is rarely better than casting the Phial.
Lamplighter's buff scales on your lowest-Health unit, so it gives little and is easy to forget.
Treacle Painter's flat +1/+1 fades by midgame.

flags.note: Pavonia grows multiplicatively each turn with no ceiling; with The Alchymist each cast reaches her twice over.
Golden Atropos plus golden Counter Clerk makes gold from refreshes until the refresh price climbs.
With a merged Phial past 20, Burnet deals 60+ damage a fight; bounded, but a spike.
